baseline_models.focus_anchor: خلق السماوات والأرض في ستة أيام ثم استوى على العرش
baseline_models.mechanism: Measured creation unfolds through a counted duration and culminates in an elevated royal seat, linking calibration, sequence, and settled governance.

activation_trace.role: Estimation and measure make creation a calibrated act rather than an unstructured onset.
The counted six fixes an articulated sequence.
A duration of time supplies stages for that sequence.
Elevation and settlement supply the transition's governing posture.
The raised royal seat gives that posture a sovereignty-bearing terminus.

changed_reading.before: A bare statement that creation occurred before enthronement.
changed_reading.after: A calibrated temporal work reaches settled governance; sequence itself belongs to the ordering mechanism.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: ما يلج في الأرض وما يخرج منها وما ينزل من السماء وما يعرج فيها
baseline_models.mechanism: Upper and lower domains form a permeable vertical system: entry and emergence cross the ground boundary while descent and ascent cross the sky boundary, and every transit is disclosed to knowledge.

activation_trace.role: What is high and covering supplies the upper domain and its boundary.
The lower counterpart to sky supplies the receiving and releasing domain.
Entry into another interior establishes an inward vector.
Penetration to the outside establishes the opposed outward vector.
Descent and arrival establish the downward vector.
Ascent establishes the answering upward vector.
Disclosure to the knower makes the whole exchange continuously legible.

changed_reading.before: A list of unrelated things God knows.
changed_reading.after: A four-vector inventory maps a layered but permeable cosmos whose boundary crossings are continuously known.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: وهو معكم أين ما كنتم والله بما تعملون بصير
baseline_models.mechanism: Presence wherever people occur is coupled directly to their intentional work and to sight, making accompaniment an action-level audit rather than a merely spatial claim.

activation_trace.role: Occurrence and presence in time anchor the unrestricted wherever-you-are construction.
Intentional action supplies the human output under accompaniment.
Visual perception makes that output inspectable rather than abstractly registered.

changed_reading.before: A general assurance that God is everywhere with people.
changed_reading.after: Unrestricted co-presence is operationalized as immediate visibility of what people intentionally do.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus's entry and exit vectors become a reciprocal phase exchange: manifest and interior are paired, night is caused to enter day and day night, and the sequence closes at the inward source from which actions issue.

activation_trace.role: The focus supplies literal penetration into an interior.
The focus supplies the counter-vector toward an exterior.
Prominence and disclosure name the manifest pole of the system.
The inside of a thing names the opposed interior pole.
Repeated causative entry makes night and day penetrate one another in reversed order.
The origin from which acts issue relocates the same interiority inside human agency.

structural_cues: 57:3 pairs manifest and interior; 57:6 repeats the same entry verb in reversed night/day order and then closes with knowledge of breasts.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: opposed surfaces/interiors, reciprocal night/day entry, and inward sources. Reader: these specify a general permeability model and connect inner source to the focus's visible work. Alternative: the reciprocity may be local to night and day rather than a rule for every focus transit.

changed_reading.before: The focus lists separately observed one-way movements.
changed_reading.after: It sketches interpenetrating phases whose outward actions remain traceable to hidden interiors.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus's descent and egress verbs are reused in a purpose chain: signs are delivered downward in order to bring people outward into light. Physical transit therefore acquires a communicative and ethical rendering.

activation_trace.role: The focus supplies literal downward arrival from the sky.
The focus supplies movement through a boundary toward the outside.
Caused delivery turns descent into transmission of signs.
Caused emergence makes recipients the object moved from concealment.
Illumination supplies the destination and perceptible result of the transit.

structural_cues: 57:9 links sending down signs to bringing people out with an explicit purpose construction and a darkness-to-light endpoint.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: descent, caused egress, purpose, and illumination. Reader: the physical axis in 57:4 also models disclosure that changes its recipients. Alternative: the two axes may remain parallel analogies rather than one mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Descent and emergence denote only cosmic or material traffic.
changed_reading.after: They also form a transmission path: disclosed signs descend, cross into reception, and produce human emergence into visibility.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earthly entry and exit resolve into a regenerative material process: sky-borne rain activates lifeless ground, growth emerges, and the visible product dries into fragments. Knowledge spans formation and decay, not just punctual crossings.

activation_trace.role: Soft fertile earth supplies a substrate with latent productive capacity.
Downward arrival supplies the input vector toward that substrate.
Outward penetration supplies the emergence vector from it.
Earth's life through rain and vegetation identifies activation of the substrate.
Loss of force and life supplies the dormant state that revival reverses.
Life-giving rain descending from sky specifies the entering material.
Vegetation emerging from earth specifies the exiting product.
Dry matter breaking into fragments extends the process through decay.

structural_cues: 57:17 directly revives earth after death; 57:20 sequences rain, vegetation, drying, yellowing, and debris.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: revival plus an explicit rain-to-growth-to-debris sequence. Reader: this sequence materially instantiates 57:4's down/into/out vectors and extends them across a life cycle. Alternative: 57:20 may function only as an analogy for worldly life, not an unpacking of the focus's earth traffic.

changed_reading.before: What enters and exits earth is an unspecified inventory.
changed_reading.after: The inventory can be read as earth metabolism: received descent becomes emergent life and then visible decay under continuous knowledge.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated descent delivers book, balance, and iron into human use; the purpose clauses lead from those provisions to enacted justice and disclosed support. Cosmic governance thus becomes a provisioning-to-action pipeline.

activation_trace.role: The focus supplies the downward-arrival channel.
Disclosure to the knower supplies total process awareness.
Intentional work supplies the human output seen at the end of the process.
Repeated caused delivery assigns the same channel to scripture, balance, and iron.
The balance of justice supplies a normative measuring instrument.
Justice and equity name the social output expected from that measure.
Iron and resistant solidity supply material force alongside the textual and measuring provisions.
Knowing who gives support closes provision with disclosed human response.

structural_cues: 57:25 repeats 'We sent down,' then gives paired purpose clauses: people uphold justice and God knows who supports Him and His messengers.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: delivered instruments, justice, material force, human support, and divine knowing. Reader: these form an implementation pipeline that concretizes 57:4's governance and sight of work. Alternative: 'sent down' may mark bestowal without extending the focus's spatial mechanics.

changed_reading.before: The focus's vertical traffic is cosmological and its sight of work is appended afterward.
changed_reading.after: Descent can deploy means into history, while seen human work is the response those means enable and test.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses non-dominant split mappings rather than the ordinary sky branch. It remains packet-valid because both mappings are explicitly attached to the focus root and interact with its entry and descent verbs; downstream prose must label it a material heuristic, not a translation or lexical claim.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: السماوات / السماء (root س م و, words 4 and 24) beside entry, descent, and ascent

activation_trace.role: The split-root image of a narrow aperture makes the upper boundary imaginably porous.
The split-root image of first rain marking earth makes descent leave a readable surface trace.
Interior entry supplies the crossing action needed by the aperture heuristic.
Downward arrival supplies the rain-like movement that can mark the lower surface.

changed_reading.before: Sky is only the upper region from which things descend.
changed_reading.after: As a form-distant heuristic, the sky-ground interface becomes a marked porous membrane: passage occurs through openings and descent leaves legible traces.

strongest_changes: Night/day reciprocity turns the focus's transit list into a model of interpenetrating phases and hidden interiors.
The descent-and-egress chain of signs makes the same axis communicative and transformative, not merely physical.
Rain, growth, debris, and the later delivery of book, balance, and iron render cosmic governance as material process and accountable implementation.
summary.what_was_special: The context repeatedly reuses the focus's transit grammar in different domains while preserving one mechanism: ordered provision crosses a boundary, produces an observable output, and remains known from source through result.
remaining_uncertainties: The reciprocal model may be licensed specifically by night and day rather than by every movement in 57:4.
Institutional 'descent' may be analogical bestowal rather than the same spatial channel as sky descent.
The marked-membrane outlier depends on packet-supplied split mappings and must remain explicitly form-distant.
